notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section, Pub. L. 103–454, title III, § 302, Nov. 2, 1994, 108 Stat. 4793, which set out definitions, was omitted from the Code as being of special and not general application.

notes.heading: Short Title
notes.text: Pub. L. 103–454, title III, § 301, Nov. 2, 1994, 108 Stat. 4793, provided that title III of Pub. L. 103–454, enacting this subchapter, could be cited as the “Paskenta Band Restoration Act”.

ancestors.heading: PASKENTA BAND OF NOMLAKI INDIANS OF CALIFORNIA
